blocks.text: Fig 15.14 lens ki ubhri (convex) satah ko hamwar sheeshe ki plate se chhoota dikhati hai. Dono satahon ke darmiyan hawa ki patli tah banti hai. Aik rang ki roshni mein dekhne par yeh intizam gol interference fringes dikhata hai (Fig 15.15, kitab mein tasveer). Newton ne inhein parha aur yeh Newton's rings kehlate hain.

blocks.alt: Plano-convex lens, seedhi satah oopar, hamwar sheeshe ki plate par rakha aur markaz par chhoota hua. Kinare ke qareeb aik shua neeche aati hai aur motai t wali hawa ki patli tah ke oopar aur neeche se mun'akis do shuaein aankh tak jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.14: Sheeshe ki plate se chhoota convex lens (kitab ki Figure 15.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Gol manzar jis mein hum-markaz andhere aur roshan halqe hain aur markaz par andhera nuqta; markaz se door halqe qareeb qareeb hote jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.15: Gol interference fringes (kitab ki tasveer Figure 15.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Markaz par lens aur plate chhoote hain, is liye wahan hawa ki motai sifar hai; phir bhi markaz andhera hai kyunke neeche wali satah se mun'akis lehar aadhe chakkar (half cycle) ka phase badal leti hai. Bahar ki taraf hawa ki tah tezi se moti hoti hai, is liye halqe qareeb qareeb aate hain.

Newton's rings tab bante hain jab plano-convex lens hamwar sheeshe ki plate par rakha jaye, taake un ke darmiyan hawa ki patli tah ho, jo chhoone ke nuqte par sab se patli aur bahar ki taraf moti ho. Sodium lamp jaise aik rang ke source ki roshni is hawa ki tah ki oopar aur neeche dono satahon se mun'akis hoti hai. Mun'akis shuaein rasta farq aur phase shift ke mutabiq constructive (roshan halqe) ya destructive (andhere halqe) interference karti hain. Kyunke markaz se barabar faasle ke tamam nuqton par tah ki motai barabar hai, fringes daire hain. Newton's rings se aik rang ki roshni ki wavelength aur lenses ka radius of curvature maloom kiya ja sakta hai, aur bareek optics mein satah ki kharabiyan pakri jati hain.

blocks.prompt: Newton's rings ka markazi nuqta andhera kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Chhoone ke nuqte par hawa ki tah ki motai taqreeban sifar hai, is liye rasta farq nahi, lekin sheeshe ki plate se mun'akis lehar (hawa se sheeshe par) aadhe chakkar ka phase shift leti hai. Is liye dono mun'akis lehrein aadha chakkar out of phase ho kar khatam ho jati hain.

items: Newton's rings: plano-convex lens aur hamwar sheeshe ke darmiyan hawa ki tah.
Gol fringes kyunke barabar motai dairon par; andhera markaz.
Istemal: wavelength, radius of curvature, satah ki jaanch.
